title: How To Get All Of The Drops You Missed During Fortnite Treasure Hunters
summary: Fortnite™ Golden Week begins at 9AM ET on Saturday, November 28. Get a full breakdown of the event, including what drops you can earn and important dates.
body_markdown:
The season of giving is fast approaching, and, boy, is Fortnite™ giving back. For the entire week from November 28th to December 5th (the end of the Treasure Hunters mini season) Fortnite™ is going golden. But what does this Golden Week mean for you? In short: increased chances for golden loot, including drops you may have missed out on earlier in the Treasure Hunters event.


Here’s the full breakdown, per the developers:


- All Gold Outfits, Vehicles, Back Blings / Pickaxes, Jam Tracks, and Loading Screens from previous captain weeks will be back in chests, along with new treasure.
- The Solid Gold Captain X Outfit will arrive a day early.
- The chance of finding any piece of treasure in a chest is increased from 1 in 62 to 1 in 21, excluding duplicates you already own.


- You can still find treasure at these rates for your squad, even if you already have it.


- While certain classes of loot may have increased drop chances, each unique treasure retains its standard drop rate.


- The developers explain this in terms of vehicles:
- “...With the possibility to get five Vehicles, the opportunity to find any Vehicle is increased. If you haven’t found any Gold Vehicles, getting any one Gold Vehicle is 1 in 1,563 - while finding a specific Gold Vehicle is still the same 1 in 7,813 drop rate.”


- The base drop rate of all Gold Outfits will be boosted by 2x during Golden Week, with even higher boosts during Treasure Hours.
- More Sprite chests will be on the map,
- All Sprite variants will appear more often.
- Players will receive Mastery Monday benefits all week (2x Sprite Dust and 2x Sprite XP).


**Important times to note:**


- **Golden Week** begins at **9AM ET on Saturday, November 28.**
- **Golden Community Day** starts at **9AM ET** on **Saturday, December 5** . Log in to earn the **Golden Community ’Brella** and more.
- The **Golden Jonesy Outfit** will be available via Twitch Drops from **9 AM ET Saturday, December 5 to 9 AM ET Monday, December 7.**


**And here are the drop rates for Treasure Hours on November 28:**


- 15x Gold Outfits (7.5x w/ 2x Golden Week boost)
- 10x Vehicles & Decals
- 1.5x Pirate Shop Access


While there’s a ton of golden goodies coming to Fortnite™ for Golden Week, the infamous Pirate Shop Token (which grants free shop access for a limited period of time, amounting to hundreds of V-Bucks in savings on skins and more) seems to remain as illusive as ever. You can enjoy the same slightly increased drop chance of 1.5x during Treasure Hours, but outside of that, the drop rate remains at 1 in 137,500.


However, if you’re looking for a treasure you don’t have to open a million chests for, check out the[Victrix™ Pro BFG™ Reloaded Wireless Modular Controller – Fortnite™ Drift](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/victrix-pro-bfg-reloaded-wireless-controller-fortnite-drift?Platform=PC) .


The BFG™ Reloaded offers 11 interchangeable components and 3 customizable modules so you can customize your controller to your preference


. Anti-Drift, Hall-Effect thumbsticks and the elite Sniper Stick also make this a perfect go-to tool for FPS gamers. Combine that with the bold, officially licensed Drift design and downloadable in-game item included with each controller, you have everything a Fortnite™ fan could dream of, except maybe that Pirate Token.
